company.shortDescription: Nox Metals is an AI-powered metals supplier empowering modern American manufacturing at scale.
company.description: Nox Metals is a software-driven raw metal supply platform built for industrial manufacturers. Its AI-powered system handles quoting, cut-path optimization, inventory management, order tracking, and shipping, helping factories and machining operations source materials more quickly and at lower cost without relying on intermediaries.
